name: orchestrator
description: Turns a session into the orchestrator of the development pipeline. It triages one ticket, then starts one child session per stage (spec, design, build, review, QA, harvest, ship). Each child ends with a STAGE REPORT, and a script checks it against the stage's completion contract. A miss gets one nudge to the same child; a second miss stops and asks you. Every status is a stage table, a PR table, and a Needs-you line. Approval gates always wait for your words.
